headline: Binance withdrawals are still paused as it targets a phased restart early Sunday and reserve results by 2 Nov, while bitcoin heads for a losing October.

market.asOf: Read from CoinGecko (BTC) and CoinMarketCap (Fear and Greed) at about 04:10 UTC Sat 31 Oct (11:10 Bangkok). Check the live prices at the top of the page.
market.fearGreed: 35 out of 100 on CoinMarketCap's Crypto Fear and Greed Index, read about 04:10 UTC 31 Oct.

stories.title: Binance withdrawals still paused; phased restart targeted for early Sunday
stories.summary: No source found by this edition says withdrawals have restarted. Binance's latest timeline points to a phased restart around 12:33 Bangkok time on Sunday 1 Nov, subject to security checks, with Proof of Reserves results (a public check that customer balances are fully backed) due before 2 Nov.
points: Per ChainCatcher, Binance said it would 'gradually restore withdrawal services within approximately 34 hours', which it puts at about 13:33 (UTC+8) on 1 Nov, after a reserve snapshot at about 15:33 (UTC+8) on 31 Oct.
Binance says it has more than $6.34B of company funds ready, including about $5B already held in the affected tokens, covering roughly 80% of the losses, per ChainCatcher.
The FBI said it is 'aware of the incident', the US Secret Service is working with Circle and others to freeze and trace funds, and Abu Dhabi's FSRA is 'engaging closely with Binance', per Reuters.

CFTC Chairman Michael Selig called them 'unregulated offshore exchanges', and Sen. Cynthia Lummis said the CLARITY Act would have given crypto firms legal cover to freeze suspicious transactions, per The Block.

stories.title: Bitcoin heads for a losing October as ETF money flows out
stories.summary: Bitcoin is on track for a monthly loss after a tech-led stock sell-off on Friday, and US spot bitcoin and ether funds saw money leave in the latest reported session.
points: Cointelegraph, citing CoinGlass, said bitcoin was set to close October 7.7% lower, its worst October since 2014; CoinDesk had it down 8.4% for the month at 3:24pm ET Friday.
US spot bitcoin ETFs had net outflows of $643.2M and ether ETFs $155.7M in the latest reported session, ending a four-session inflow run for bitcoin funds, per TokenPost.
Friday's close: Nasdaq down 2.86%, S&P 500 down 1.82%, Dow down 1.09%, and the semiconductor index down 7.20%, per CappNotes.
Reuters reported a six-week bitcoin low of $76,368 and a two-month ether low of $2,178.

stories.title: Following the stolen money: about $3B frozen, but more is still movable
stories.summary: Blockchain trackers give slightly different totals for how much was stolen and frozen, so each is named. Elliptic says the attacker still controls billions that token issuers cannot freeze, and the stolen bitcoin had not yet reached any service.
points: Amount stolen: Binance says about $6.3B; TRM about $6.36B at time-of-theft prices; Elliptic $6.43B; Chainalysis about $6.4B.
Amount frozen: Binance says about $3B; Elliptic has verified $2.84B; Chainalysis about $2.8B; TRM about $2.7B.
Elliptic says the attacker controls about $3.33B that issuers cannot freeze, and the 18,270 stolen BTC sits across 19 addresses with none of it yet sent to a service.
TRM and Chainalysis attribute the hack to North Korea's TraderTraitor group; North Korea denies involvement, per Reuters.

briefs.title: Liquidations near $1.6B
briefs.summary: Rolling 24-hour liquidations of leveraged bets reached $1.56B, with longs at $1.31B, per Cointelegraph citing CoinGlass.

briefs.title: Institutions pull funds from exchanges
briefs.summary: Institutional investors are rushing to withdraw digital assets from centralized exchanges after the hack, per CoinDesk; CertiK put Q3 hack losses at $1.28B.

briefs.title: Coinbase and OKX tighten security
briefs.summary: Coinbase moved key-storage systems offline 'solely out of an abundance of caution', and OKX's CEO proposed an industry alert-and-freeze system, per CryptoProwl via Yahoo Finance.

briefs.title: Aave reopens its markets
briefs.summary: Aave resumed lending and borrowing after a precautionary freeze; stablecoins and some gold-linked tokens can't yet back new loans, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: US buyers look weak
briefs.summary: Bitcoin's price on Coinbase fell to a deep discount versus other venues, about two standard deviations below its annual average, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Tether reports $1.5B Q3 profit
briefs.summary: Tether's excess reserves rose to $7.95B from $4.1B, per CoinDesk.

briefs.title: Gold at a one-year low, oil higher
briefs.summary: December gold fell 3.3% to $3,898.90 on Friday while US oil (WTI) rose 2.08% to $104.12, per CappNotes.

calendar.note: Target about 13:33 (UTC+8) on 1 Nov, subject to security checks, per ChainCatcher. Forbes reports 'this weekend'.
